name: Prabhas Tours and Travels
tagline: Travel with Comfort, Return with Memories!
shortAbout: Your trusted travel partner for a comfortable, safe and memorable journey. Prabhas Tours and Travels makes every journey special!
fullAbout: Prabhas Tours and Travels is your trusted travel partner based in Lasurne, Tal. Indapur, Dist. Pune, Maharashtra. We offer domestic tour packages for families, groups, students and corporate tours, complete booking facility for all types of tours and travel arrangements, travel management for corporate and private clients, hygienic vegetarian meal arrangements, and experienced, polite drivers for a safe journey.
philosophy: Your journey, our responsibility. We make travel memorable!
safetyPromise: All our vehicles are clean, well maintained and inspected before every trip. Our experienced and polite drivers ensure punctuality, reliability, and your safety throughout the journey.
